en: A vintage postcard showing the main square of a small European town. Prominent on the left is a multi-story building with a tower featuring a clock, likely the town hall (Rathaus). Classic European architecture lines the street, and people dressed in old-fashioned clothing stand in the square. Trees and a fountain are visible in the foreground. The overall tone and imagery suggest an early 20th-century setting. The postcard contains German-language text.
